changes: First release. The AMP envelope reworked: AMP HLD runs from no hold (0) to AUTO (127) without cutting the attack; ATK, AMP DEC, FILTER DEC and REL and AMP HLD get fine steps at short times (0.2 ms to 5 ms); every envelope knob shows its time; FUNC + turn on HLD steps 0, 124.7 ms, AUTO; SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET gains AMP (Env Reset Amp, with a pre-fade).
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
